scope.npm: Every non-root package-lock.json entry, including development-only and optional packages. Development flags come from the lockfile; production-or-optional does not prove inclusion in the emitted application.
scope.cargo: cargo metadata --locked --offline without --filter-platform: all target triples in the resolved dependency graph, including build/dev/transitive dependencies; conservative superset, not a per-binary linkage claim. Workspace members excluded. --all-features is not enabled.
scope.evidence: Original bytes of LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT/UNLICENSE files and license/notice directory contents recursively found in local package trees, excluding nested node_modules, VCS directories and target. Symlinks are skipped. Collection is not a legal-compliance decision; empty/no standalone license is reported.
scope.sourceURLs: Package archive URLs and lock integrity are recorded. Audited supplements were fetched separately from exact npm/crates archives or pinned commits and are verified against the current lock; original bytes and linkage evidence are in compliance/third-party-sources/license-evidence. Source archives are retained for the recorded MPL/EPL/native components.
scope.exclusions: Local vendored renderers/fonts, OS/WebView runtimes, unlisted embedded third-party components, upstream bundled code without separately named notices, modified downstream source, patents, trademarks and commercial-service terms need separate review.

correspondingSource.statement: The original unpinned generated ELK input is not distributed. ZiEdit uses the fixed-source 0.9.3-ziedit-source.1 rebuild with complete source, original component licenses, generated Java, exact locks, modifications and reproducibility proof published in the ZiEdit source repository at compliance/third-party-sources/elkjs/ (see repository and source archive URLs below). The npm elkjs entry is an upstream dependency identity, not the redistributed engine binary.
